items.question: 어제 순 방문자 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS yesterday_unique_visitors
FROM agg_daily_users
WHERE summary_date = current_date - 1

items.question: 최근 7일 일별 페이지뷰 추이를 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT
  summary_date,
  SUM(page_views) AS page_views
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY summary_date
ORDER BY summary_date;

items.question: 최근 30일 동안 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT event_name, SUM(event_count) AS event_count
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 30
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY event_count DESC

items.question: 지난주 페이지뷰가 가장 많은 페이지 5개는?
items.sql:
SELECT page_path, SUM(page_views) AS total_page_views
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY page_path
ORDER BY total_page_views DESC
LIMIT 5;

items.question: 지난주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  SUM(sessions) AS session_count
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY session_count DESC;

items.question: 지난주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 이탈률(%)은?
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  ROUND(sum(bounced_sessions) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sum(sessions), 0), 2) AS bounce_rate_pct
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY bounce_rate_pct DESC;

items.question: 최근 14일 기기 유형별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT device_type, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14 AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY sessions DESC;

items.question: 이번 달 결제 완료 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ad.event_count), 0)::bigint AS 결제완료건수
FROM agg_event_daily ad
JOIN conversion_events ce ON ce.event_name = ad.event_name
WHERE ad.summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date
  AND ad.event_name = 'is_payment'
  AND ce.is_active = 1;

items.question: 어제 성별 방문자 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT gender, SUM(users) AS visitor_count
FROM agg_user_session_daily
WHERE summary_date = current_date - 1
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY gender;

items.question: 최근 7일 연령대별 평균 세션 시간(초)은?
items.sql:
SELECT
  age_group,
  sum(session_duration_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(sessions), 0) AS avg_session_seconds
FROM agg_user_session_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY age_group;

items.question: 지난주 시간대(0~23시)별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT summary_hour,
       sum(sessions)::bigint AS total_sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY summary_hour
ORDER BY summary_hour;

items.question: 최근 7일 nov_mega_sale 캠페인의 유입 소스·매체별 세션 수와 전환 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  traffic_medium,
  SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions,
  SUM(conversions) AS total_conversions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
  AND traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC, total_conversions DESC, traffic_source, traffic_medium

items.question: 최근 7일 페이지뷰 100회 이상인 페이지 중 평균 체류 시간(초)이 가장 긴 5개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  page_path,
  SUM(page_views) AS page_views,
  SUM(time_on_page_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(page_views), 0) AS avg_time_on_page_seconds
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY page_path
HAVING SUM(page_views) >= 100
ORDER BY avg_time_on_page_seconds DESC, page_path
LIMIT 5;

items.question: 15일 전 기기 유형별로 /checkout/success 페이지를 본 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  device_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM events
WHERE page_path = '/checkout/success'
  AND timestamp >= (current_date - 15)::timestamp
  AND timestamp < (current_date - 14)::timestamp
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  COALESCE(sum(sessions) FILTER (
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
      AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  ), 0) AS last_week_sessions,
  COALESCE(sum(sessions) FILTER (
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  ), 0) AS this_week_sessions,
  COALESCE(sum(sessions) FILTER (
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  ), 0) - COALESCE(sum(sessions) FILTER (
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
      AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  ), 0) AS session_diff
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY this_week_sessions DESC, last_week_sessions DESC, traffic_source;

items.question: 지난주 세션 100개 이상인 유입 소스·매체 중 전환율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  traffic_medium,
  SUM(sessions) AS sessions,
  SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
  ROUND(SUM(conversions) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium
HAVING SUM(sessions) >= 100
ORDER BY conversion_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3;

items.question: 최근 28일 동안 요일별(ISO 요일 번호, 월=1) 하루 평균 세션 수는?
items.sql:
WITH daily_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    summary_date,
    SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
  EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date)::int AS iso_weekday,
  ROUND(AVG(total_sessions)::numeric, 2) AS avg_daily_sessions
FROM daily_sessions
GROUP BY EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date)::int
ORDER BY iso_weekday;

items.question: 최근 7일 기기 유형별 결제 전환율(%)을 알려줘. 결제(is_payment) 이벤트가 있었던 세션의 비율로 계산해줘
items.sql:
WITH session_device AS (
  SELECT device_type, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
  FROM agg_user_session_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY device_type
),
payment_sessions AS (
  SELECT device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS paying_sessions
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'is_payment'
    AND timestamp >= current_date - 7
    AND timestamp < current_date
  GROUP BY device_type
)
SELECT COALESCE(session_device.device_type, payment_sessions.device_type) AS device_type,
       COALESCE(payment_sessions.paying_sessions, 0) AS paying_sessions,
       COALESCE(session_device.sessions, 0) AS sessions,
       ROUND(
         COALESCE(payment_sessions.paying_sessions, 0) * 100.0
         / NULLIF(COALESCE(session_device.sessions, 0), 0),
         2
       ) AS payment_conversion_rate_pct
FROM session_device
FULL OUTER JOIN payment_sessions
  ON payment_sessions.device_type = session_device.device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 일평균 순 방문자 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH daily_uv AS (
  SELECT summary_date, COUNT(*) AS uv
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 7 THEN uv ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric / 7
    AS recent_7d_avg_daily_uv,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN summary_date < current_date - 7 THEN uv ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric / 7
    AS previous_7d_avg_daily_uv,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 7 THEN uv ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric / 7
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN summary_date < current_date - 7 THEN uv ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric / 7
    AS avg_daily_uv_difference
FROM daily_uv;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수 변화를 보여줘
items.sql:
WITH weekly_event_counts AS (
  SELECT
    event_name,
    date_trunc('week', summary_date)::date AS week_start,
    sum(event_count) AS event_count
  FROM agg_event_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date + 7
  GROUP BY event_name, date_trunc('week', summary_date)::date
),
week_compare AS (
  SELECT
    event_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(event_count) FILTER (
      WHERE week_start = date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    ), 0)::bigint AS last_week_event_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(event_count) FILTER (
      WHERE week_start = date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    ), 0)::bigint AS this_week_event_count
  FROM weekly_event_counts
  GROUP BY event_name
)
SELECT
  event_name,
  last_week_event_count,
  this_week_event_count,
  this_week_event_count - last_week_event_count AS event_count_change,
  CASE
    WHEN last_week_event_count = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (this_week_event_count - last_week_event_count)::numeric * 100.0 / last_week_event_count
  END AS event_count_change_pct
FROM week_compare
ORDER BY event_name;
